newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria sees CA share swap in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria sees CA share swap in Sept.

text.p: Bank Austria, the nation's biggest bank, said on Thursday it expected to finalise an exchange offer for Creditanstalt shares and participation certificates by the end of September.

The offer to Creditanstalt shareholders, which will be based on auditors' valuations of both banks, would require approval at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting, Bank Austria chief executive Gerhard Randa said.
"I expect we will have the (share exchange ratio) at the end of August or early September," he told a news conference.
The bank would call two extraordinary shareholders' meetings in September, Randa said, adding: "The exchange will take place directly afterwards."
Auditors Deloitte Touche, KPMG and investment banks Salomon Brothers and J.P. Morgan are assessing the value of the two banks, which formally came under one roof in March.
Under the terms of the deal, Bank Austria agreed to buy out Creditanstalt shareholders by offering them its shares. Small shareholders would also be given the option of 722.5 schillings cash.
